missing_evidence.APCTT-C01: No target-specific passage establishes: Basic principles (TRL 1): the report states the scientific or engineering principles on which the assessed technology is based, citing observations, studies or literature.
missing_evidence.APCTT-C02: No target-specific passage establishes: Concept formulated (TRL 2): the report describes a practical application of those principles and how the assessed technology is intended to work in it.
missing_evidence.APCTT-C03: No target-specific passage establishes: Proof of concept (TRL 3): the report presents analytical or laboratory results that demonstrate the critical function or characteristic of the assessed technology.
missing_evidence.APCTT-C04: No target-specific passage establishes: Laboratory validation (TRL 4): the report states that the assessed component or a low-fidelity breadboard was tested in a laboratory environment and reports the results.
missing_evidence.APCTT-C05: No target-specific passage establishes: Relevant-environment validation (TRL 5): the report states that the assessed component or breadboard was tested in a simulated or relevant environment representative of the intended environment, and reports the results.
missing_evidence.APCTT-C06: No target-specific passage establishes: Prototype in relevant environment (TRL 6): the report states that a representative model or prototype of the assessed system or subsystem was demonstrated in a relevant environment.
missing_evidence.APCTT-C07: No target-specific passage establishes: Prototype in operational environment (TRL 7): the report states that a prototype close to the final configuration was demonstrated in the actual operational environment.
missing_evidence.APCTT-C08: No target-specific passage establishes: System qualified (TRL 8): the report states that the final system was completed and qualified through test and demonstration against its requirements.
missing_evidence.APCTT-C09: No target-specific passage establishes: Proven in operation (TRL 9): the report states that the final system was used successfully in actual operations or deployment over a stated period.
missing_evidence.APCTT-C10: No target-specific passage establishes: Quantified results against requirements: the report compares measured performance with stated requirements or acceptance criteria and says whether they were met.
missing_evidence.APCTT-C11: No target-specific passage establishes: Environment and test article defined: the report describes the test conditions and the configuration or fidelity of the tested article (for example breadboard, prototype, production unit) relative to the intended application.
missing_evidence.APCTT-C12: No target-specific passage establishes: Evidence matches the assessment target: the cited evidence concerns the assessed target itself (component, subsystem, system or technology), not a different element or only the parent project as a whole.
